notes.title: Update V0.4 "Modding and Enviornment"
notes.content: [p][b]This Includes V0.36-V0.4 Builds 86-128[/b][/p][p][b]Added:[/b][/p][p]-Titles and NameTags in-game, by completing certain tasks you can unlock a title that will display under your name. NameTags appear within 5 meters of another player[/p][p]-New Grass[/p][p]-New Cloud System[/p][p]-Sidemap_19 (First Properly sized map (This will be the official 'Small' Map)[/p][p]-New Cliff Rocks[/p][p]-Backend Animal Manager (Increases performance)[/p][p]-Crafting can now pull from multiple item stacks... yes very overdue[/p][p]-First fully functional aliens test[/p][p]-Dedicated Server Support[/p][p]-Increased the amount of available performance options[/p][p]-Full Mod Support and Tool Kit (The Tool Kit is an external application)[/p][p][b]Modding Details:[/b][/p][p]-The kit allows you to create any map or mod you want, the limitations have yet to be found.[/p][p]-A Full video tutorial series will be released on the Modding Kit when it is officially released to the public.[/p][p]-The Release will most likely be a month or two before the full game release to allow modders the time to make mods for the release of the game.[/p][p]-Update V0.5 Will go over more details[/p][p][b]Changed:[/b][/p][p]-Completely redid Biome system, biomes now only tick when being used, they now instantaneously update when entering a new biome [/p][p](prevents biome randomly dropping to the outside temperature when going between indoor rooms, this previously could cause false damage)[/p][p]-Revamped Woodland forest generation, these forests now have proper canopies and undergrowth[/p][p]-Upgraded Tech Tree systems[/p][p]-Walk speed Lowered (600 -> 450)[/p][p]-Sprinting speed Lowered (1200 -> 900)[/p][p]-Sidemap_19 Carries with it the new lighting and post process[/p][p]Through the advent of larger worlds some items need rebalancing because you can now gather them easier[/p][p]-Cooked Meat, Hunger Satisfaction 40->20, Hp Recovery 17->8[/p][p]-Purified Water, Thirst Satisfaction 40->7,[/p][p]-Processed Fruit, Hunger Satisfaction 10->4, Hp Recovery 5->1.2[/p][p]-Fruit, Hunger Satisfaction 15->2, Hp Recovery 5->1, Thirst Satisfaction 7->3[/p][p][b]Fixes:[/b][/p][p]-Animals acting strange (Not eating or fighting) on large maps (Instanced Foliage maps)[/p][p]-LargeMap Animals extremely optimized[/p][p]-Animal performance increased ~75%[/p][p]-Total Game performance increase ~25%[/p][p]-Animal Tames sometimes not saving whether or not they are large enough to be ridden[/p][p][b]Future:[/b][/p][p]-The Playtest will be soon (1-2 months)[/p]

notes.title: DEMO RELEASING NOW!!!!!! (Update V0.29)
notes.content:
Added:
-More parts of the Tutorial
-Item Pickup indicator (thing that pops up telling you what you picked up)
-Sounds for: Fire/Cooking, Sprinting, Damage

Fixed:

-Temperature Sync issue (Multiplayer)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44694310/9af3c5f0bc5caa31f6aad63e7eb5c408578b06eb.png[/img]

[b]DEMO FEATURE LISTS:[/b]

Demo Features:
-Crafting
-Building
-Animal Taming (Very Crude)
-Animal Riding (Very Crude)
-Star Simulation
-3 Weather conditions (Cloudless, Partly Cloudy, and Fog)
-Save game (only player and their items, not the plants, animals, or star)
-A Demo gameplay loop (Accelerated loop to give you a taste of all 3 loops (Early, Middle, Late) in a shortened timespan)
-Example Cosmetics
-PVP
-Full Multiplayer support

The Demo WILL NOT Include:
-Attacking players while riding an animal
-Most of the Production Models
-Some Current items and ALL Planned Items (Higher tier tools etc.)
-A realistic gameplay timespan (The demo is planned to last around 30 minutes)


The Demo MIGHT Include (In the future):
-Better Animals

[b]DEMO FAQs:[/b]
Q: How long is the demo?
A: Around 20-30 minutes if you are playing solo, if you are in a multiplayer session it could realistically have many many hours of gameplay

Q: Will the Demo Be Updated?
A: Probably, at least right after launch, I'm sure there will be a few bugs that need fixing

Q: How in depth will the Demo Be?
A: The Demo will feature a taste from each tier of equipment. You'll have a few primitive early on items, a few middle tier weapons like the Mako Assault Rifle, and some later weapons like the Mortar

Q: Will the Demo stay around after the full game releases?
A: Maybe, It will depend on what happens between now and that time

Q: If I find a bug, where should I report it?
A: PLEASE Report any bugs in the "Bugs/Issues" Discussion on steam

[b]Developer Notes:[/b]
-Please remember that almost everything is subject to change. If you have suggestions now is the time to put them in the Suggestions discussion.
-Some of the models are TERRIBLE, I know. It's the demo, it represents the gameplay, not necessarily the looks
-Most importantly, have fun.

-DrierWhisper729

notes.title: Major Update "1/4 Till V1!" V0.25
notes.content:
Major Update Build 64 V0.25 

Added:
-Unlimited (Limited) Power!!!!!!!
-Generator
-Light
-Health Flask (Healing Potion) (Heals 30 Hp) (Takes 2 Fruit to craft)
-Toxic Fruit Cannon, Shoots a spread of toxic fruit that splash on the ground creating a cloud that can hurt you and animals overtime
-WindMills/GrainMills/GrainTurbines, these take seeds and can grind them up into a sort of seed "Flour" than can be put on a campfire to make "Bread"

Rebalances:
-Cooked meat now gives 17 Hp back instead of 30 to make there be a reason to use the health flask whilst not making the health flask Overpowered
-Aggressive Animal's %chance to target player is now a range from 0.05-0.09 instead of a set 0.07 (This will become dynamic in the future)
-Changed the way in which animal energy consumption is calculated.

Coming:
-Large Projectile weapons (EX: Rocket Launchers, Mortars, Grenades, Artillery...)
